name: ConversationList
summary: The person's conversations with an assistant, grouped by when (Today, Yesterday, Previous 7 days) or by project, the open one marked. Each row opens its conversation; its More menu (Rename in place, Share, Archive, Delete) shows on hover, on focus and on the open row, so a long list reads as titles. Not for the app's main navigation (Navigation) or a list of things to choose from (List).
a11y: A `nav` named by `label`; each group is a heading and a list of links, the open one `aria-current="page"`. Each row's More button is named after the conversation ("More for Weekend walk…") and stays in the Tab order even when it's hidden at rest. Rename turns the title into a text field with focus in it; Escape puts focus back on the row.

keys.action: opens the conversation (on its link); keeps a new title (while renaming)

props.name: groups
props.description: The groups, in order. Empty groups aren't shown.

props.name: current
props.description: The open conversation's id: marked current (`aria-current="page"`) and its row tinted.

props.name: onOpen
props.description: A conversation chosen. With `href`, the link opens it too; call `preventDefault` on nothing, the list never does.

props.name: actions
props.description: Each row's "More" menu, in order. Default: Rename, Share, Archive, Delete. `rename` is handled in place.

props.name: onAction
props.description: A menu action other than rename, e.g. "delete": confirm destructive ones yourself (Dialog).

props.name: onRename
props.description: The new title after an in-place rename (Enter or leaving the field keeps it; Escape cancels).

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: The groups' heading level in the page's outline. Default 3.

props.name: title
props.description: Its title, usually written from the first message: "Weekend walk in the Lake District".

props.name: href
props.description: Where it opens, so it can open in a new tab and be copied; leave out to open through `onOpen` only.
